releases.author: Rome-1
releases.description:
First public release of Beads for Obsidian.

- Ready-first pane (In progress / Ready / Blocked) driven by `bd`.
- Native bead editor: Properties panel + note-style description.
- Quick capture, live `beads` code-block embeds, status-bar ready count.

Desktop only (shells out to the `bd` CLI). Requires the Beads CLI on your PATH.
